name: cGZDBSerialRecordAsIGZFile::DeletingDestructor
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Primary slot 6, returns this. Stores the two vtable words, then closes the record (record slot 3 AsPersistRecord, persist slot 6 Close), releases it (slot 2) and clears the pointer; bit 0 of the flags frees the object (operator delete). The test uses flags without bit 0 (the free would hit the test's buffer): the delete itself is library code and is not differentially covered. Compared: events, state, the vtable words left, the returned this. Mutants killed: no Close, no Release, pointer not cleared, vtable word not stored, wrong return; a removed delete survives by construction.

name: cGZDBSerialRecordAsIGZFile::GetPath#1 (the function-local static 0x10f500c, guard 0x10f502c)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). File slot 25. Thread-safe local static: on first use the guard is taken (our CRT's _Init_thread_header / _footer on the game's guard, owned statics 10f500c and 10f502c), the empty cRZString built by our constructor and an exit handler registered (ours destroys the string, as 0xd95310 does); returns the static. The test runs the original with its atexit redirected (one handler, 0xd95310), compares the resulting string bytes and checks the guard was marked and that a later call does not rebuild. Our atexit goes to our CRT's table and is not observable here.
